novel_features.name: Watchlist Digest
novel_features.description: See everything that changed across your whole watchlist since you last checked — price drops, new offers, stock changes — in one command.
novel_features.rationale: Flipkart has no server-side watchlist or change-digest; this only exists because every watched product's price history is persisted locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this instead of re-checking N product pages by hand — it answers 'what changed' in one call.

novel_features.name: Multi-Product Compare
novel_features.description: Line up 2 or more products side by side — price, rating, discount, key specs — in one table instead of copy-pasting across tabs.
novel_features.rationale: Requires fetching N product-detail records and computing a unified diff — no single Flipkart page or API call does this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when deciding between a shortlist of similar products rather than fetching each individually.

novel_features.name: Feed Digest With Auto Cursor
novel_features.description: Pull the official Delta Feed API without manually tracking the last fromVersion — the CLI remembers it — and see deltas ranked by discount-percentage change.
novel_features.rationale: The raw Delta Feed API requires manual version bookkeeping and returns unranked deltas; this persists the cursor locally and ranks the output.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a weekly affiliate-catalog refresh instead of hand-tracking version numbers across runs.

novel_features.name: Saved-Search Diff
novel_features.description: Re-run a saved search and see exactly what's new, removed, or price-changed since the last time you ran it.
novel_features.rationale: Diffs two timestamped snapshots of the same query stored locally — a temporal join the live search endpoint cannot express in one call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to track a category of interest over time without hand-comparing result pages.

novel_features.name: Category Deal Scanner
novel_features.description: Scan an entire category for products above a discount threshold, and keep the results queryable offline afterward.
novel_features.rationale: Persists category matches locally so the scan compounds into a reusable local dataset instead of a one-shot filtered print.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use during sale windows to shortlist deals once, then re-query them offline without re-hitting the API.

novel_features.name: Best-Card Arbitrage
novel_features.description: Across a set of products you're considering, find the single bank card that maximizes your total stacked savings.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates the local offers table across a product set — a computation no per-product offer listing performs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before checkout when weighing which of your cards to use across a multi-item cart.

narrative.headline: Every Flipkart scraper's features, plus a local price-history and deal-tracking layer no single-shot script can offer.
narrative.value_prop: Search, product detail, and the official Affiliate API in one consistent schema — with local SQLite turning every fetch into price history, watchlist digests, and cross-product deal arbitrage.
narrative.auth_narrative: No login required for search and product lookup — the CLI replays browser-sniffed direct-HTTP requests against the public site. Users with an approved Flipkart Affiliate account can additionally set FLIPKART_AFFILIATE_ID and FLIPKART_AFFILIATE_TOKEN to unlock the official category/delta feed endpoints.

quickstart.comment: Start with a keyword search — no auth needed.
Pull full detail on one result; this also records a price-history snapshot.
Track a product so future syncs build a price history.
Refresh watched products and update local price history.
See everything that changed across your watchlist since last check.

troubleshoots.symptom: search or product get returns an HTTP 403 or empty result
troubleshoots.fix: Flipkart's anti-bot detection may be triggering; run 'flipkart-pp-cli doctor' to check transport health, and retry after a short delay.

troubleshoots.symptom: feed/delta feed commands fail with an auth error
troubleshoots.fix: Set FLIPKART_AFFILIATE_ID and FLIPKART_AFFILIATE_TOKEN — these require an approved Flipkart Affiliate account, separate from normal search/product commands.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI when comparison-shopping on Flipkart, tracking prices toward a target before a sale, or running an affiliate catalog refresh. Not for personal order history or account management — Flipkart exposes no API for that.

recipes.title: Track a product toward a target price
recipes.command: flipkart-pp-cli watch add <url> --threshold 25000 && flipkart-pp-cli sync && flipkart-pp-cli watch digest
recipes.explanation: Adds a watch, refreshes it, then shows what changed — the core price-tracking loop.

recipes.title: Compare a shortlist before buying
recipes.explanation: Narrows a side-by-side compare to just the fields that matter, keeping agent context small.

recipes.title: Find the best card for a multi-item cart
recipes.explanation: Aggregates bank/card offers across items to surface the single card with the highest total stacked savings.

recipes.title: Weekly affiliate catalog refresh
recipes.explanation: Pulls only what changed since the last run, ranked by discount-percentage change, without manual version tracking.

trigger_phrases: find me the best price on Flipkart
